# Implementation Plan: Notifications Hub UI (F04)
*Path: [kitty-specs/025-notifications-hub-ui/plan.md](kitty-specs/025-notifications-hub-ui/plan.md)*

**Branch**: `025-notifications-hub-ui` | **Date**: 2025-12-11 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `kitty-specs/025-notifications-hub-ui/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by the `/spec-kitty.plan` command based on validated planning answers.

## Summary

F04 Notifications Hub UI is a frontend-only package (`@django-core/notifications-hub`) that provides in-app notification display and management capabilities. It includes toast/snackbar notifications for real-time feedback, an inbox panel for notification history management, and an unread badge indicator. The system integrates with F01 (design system), F02 (authentication), F03 (multi-tenancy context), F06 (layouts), and consumes B13/B16/B17 APIs for notification data.

**V1 Scope**: Polling-based notification delivery, slide-out inbox panel, optimistic UI updates, configurable toast positioning, and error-focused observability. Real-time WebSocket/SSE support and full-page routes are deferred to future iterations.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.x, React 18.x
**Primary Dependencies**:
- `@django-core/design-system` (F01) - All UI components
- `@django-core/api-client` - CSRF-protected fetch, error handling
- `@django-core/auth` (F02) - Authentication context
- `@django-core/context-switcher` (F03) - Multi-tenancy context
- `react-window` or `@tanstack/react-virtual` - List virtualization
- `date-fns` or `dayjs` - Date/time formatting

**Storage**: N/A (frontend-only, consumes B13/B16/B17 REST APIs)
**Testing**: Jest 29.x, React Testing Library, MSW (Mock Service Worker)
**Target Platform**: Modern browsers (inherits from F01: last 2 major versions of Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge)
**Project Type**: Frontend package (monorepo package under `packages/`)
**Performance Goals**:
- Toast display within 1s of polling cycle
- Mark-as-read UI update within 500ms
- Inbox supports 1000+ notifications without UI lag
- Skeleton loading reduces perceived latency

**Constraints**:
- Zero custom CSS (100% F01 design tokens)
- Router-agnostic (supports React Router, Next.js, Django templates)
- Must integrate cleanly with F06 shell layouts
- Optimistic updates with rollback on API failure
- Error-focused observability only (no engagement analytics)

**Scale/Scope**:
- Single package: `@django-core/notifications-hub`
- 6 main components: ToastHost, NotificationPanel, NotificationList, NotificationItem, UnreadBadge, NotificationSkeleton
- 4 custom hooks: useNotifications, useUnreadCount, useNotificationsActions, usePolling
- React Context provider: NotificationsProvider
- Configuration system for type mappings and positioning

## Phase 0: Research ✅

**Status**: Complete (2025-12-11)

**Artifacts**:
- [research.md](research.md) - Comprehensive research document with:
  - 5 major technical decisions (real-time delivery, presentation mode, type mapping, state management, testing)
  - Best practices research (React patterns, optimistic updates, virtual scrolling, cross-tab sync)
  - Integration points for F01/F02/F03/F06/B13
  - API contract definitions
  - Risk assessment table

**Decisions Validated**:
1. Polling-first for V1 (30-60s interval), defer WebSocket/SSE to future iteration
2. Slide-out panel only for V1, full-page route deferred
3. Hybrid type mapping (defaults in F04, overridable via provider)
4. React Context + custom hooks (aligned with F02/F03, no external state lib)
5. Unit + integration tests (Jest + RTL + MSW), no E2E in V1

**Outcome**: All architectural decisions documented and aligned with constitution principles.

   - State machine diagrams (read/unread transitions, toast lifecycle, loading states)
   - API request/response contracts (GET, PATCH, POST endpoints)
   - Validation rules and error handling strategy
   - Performance considerations (pagination, caching, polling optimization)
   - Dependencies on F01/F02/F03/api-client

2. **[contracts/notifications-api.yaml](contracts/notifications-api.yaml)** - OpenAPI 3.1 specification:
   - `/notifications` (GET) - List notifications with filtering/pagination
   - `/notifications/{id}` (GET) - Get single notification
   - `/notifications/{id}/read` (PATCH) - Mark as read/unread
   - `/notifications/mark-all-read` (POST) - Bulk mark as read
   - `/notifications/unread-count` (GET) - Efficient count endpoint
   - Complete schemas for Notification, NotificationAction, NotificationList, Error
   - Authentication/CSRF security schemes
   - Error response definitions (401/403/404/500)

3. **[quickstart.md](quickstart.md)** - Integration guide for consuming applications:

   - API reference (hooks, components, props)
   - F06 layouts integration examples
   - Router integration (React Router, Next.js)
